Compare a message with the reply to it. List each concrete thing the message asks for that the reply neither handles, starts, plans nor talks about. Ignore musings and anything the reply asked back about.
Answer with exactly NONE, or one line per missed thing starting "- ", quoting the message's own words.

<message>
hivra: onboarding copy is too long cut it in half. the price page still says beta remove that. waitlist emails go to spam check the dkim thing. add a faq bit about refunds. the hero gif is 9mb make it smaller. signup button colour clashes w the logo. mobile nav overlaps the logo on small phones. need a privacy page b4 launch. stripe test mode is still on in staging i think, check. and someone pls look at why the dashbaord takes 6s to load
</message>

<reply>
Sixteen hub things, in your order. None of this is Tally, so they go in as hub changes you Apply or Discard, not as Tally commits.

1. Inbox rows still too tall on the laptop
2. Settings page scrolls weird
3. A shortcut for a new chat
4. Terminal font is tiny
5. Notes should sync between windows
6. Pin a chat to the top
7. Rail badge doesn't clear after you answer something
8. Today should show what finished overnight at the top
9. Send button shouldn't jump when the text wraps
10. Model picker forgets your pick after restart
11. A little undo after archive
12. Dark mode code blocks are unreadable
13. Search in a chat
14. Being built list should group by project, not by time
15. Archive button sits too close to delete
16. Dock icon badge is wrong half the time

Starting all sixteen as hub changes. One call I am making without asking: new-chat shortcut is ⌘N.

Nothing here needs a decision from you first. Capturing your words, then filing the changes.
</reply>
